claim: Python conditions use if/elif/else to run different blocks depending on boolean expressions.
source: General Python knowledge, user-confirmed concept set (2026-11-12)
answer_ar: الشروط في Python تستخدم if/elif/else لتنفيذ كتل مختلفة حسب تعابير منطقية، مثل: if x > 0: ... else: ....
answer_en: Python conditions use if/elif/else to run different blocks based on boolean expressions, e.g. if x > 0: ... else: ....
questions: What is an if statement in Python?

claim: A Python function is a reusable block defined with def, takes parameters and returns a value with return.
source: General Python knowledge, user-confirmed concept set (2026-11-12)
answer_ar: الدالة في Python كتلة قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام تُعرّف بـ def، تأخذ معاملات وتعيد قيمة بـ return، مثل: def add(a, b): return a + b.
answer_en: A Python function is a reusable block defined with def, takes parameters and returns a value with return, e.g. def add(a, b): return a + b.
questions: What is a function in Python?

claim: A Python list is an ordered, mutable collection written with square brackets, e.g. nums = [1, 2, 3].
source: General Python knowledge, user-confirmed concept set (2026-11-12)
answer_ar: القائمة في Python مجموعة مرتّبة قابلة للتعديل تُكتب بأقواس مربعة مثل: nums = [1, 2, 3]. تدعم الفهرسة والتقطيع والإضافة والحذف.
answer_en: A Python list is an ordered, mutable collection written with square brackets, e.g. nums = [1, 2, 3]. It supports indexing, slicing, appending and removing.
questions: What is a list in Python?

claim: Python loops repeat a block of code: for iterates over a sequence, while repeats while a condition is true.
source: General Python knowledge, user-confirmed concept set (2026-11-12)
answer_ar: الحلقات في Python تكرّر كتلة شيفرة: for تمرّ على عناصر تسلسل مثل for i in range(3)، وwhile تكرّر ما دام الشرط صحيحًا. تُستخدم لأتمتة التكرار.
answer_en: Python loops repeat a block: for iterates over a sequence (for i in range(3)), while repeats while a condition holds. They automate repetition.
questions: What is a loop in Python?

claim: In Python, a variable is a named reference to a value, created by assignment, e.g. x = 5.
source: General Python knowledge, user-confirmed concept set (2026-11-12)
answer_ar: المتغيّر في Python هو اسم مرتبط بقيمة، يُنشأ بالإسناد مثل: x = 5. لا تحتاج لتصريح نوعه، ويتغيّر نوعه بتغيّر القيمة.
answer_en: A variable in Python is a name bound to a value, created by assignment like x = 5. No type declaration is needed; the type follows the value.
questions: What is a variable in Python?
